name: byname-launch-video
description: Renders launch.html and its generated soundtrack into byname-launch.mp4. npm install, then npm run video (macOS: encodes and muxes with AVFoundation).

scripts.video: node render.mjs && swift encode.swift frames byname-launch-silent.mp4 && node audio.mjs && swift mux.swift byname-launch-silent.mp4 byname-launch.wav byname-launch.mp4
